To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have designed a SiGe cascode PA with a PAE of >30% in the frequency range of interest and that the ET-based polar TX using this PA can pass the stringent WiMAX mask and the required EVM for WiMAX 3.5-MHz 16QAM signals.
a broadband cascode amplifier with high efficiency and linearity is developed for mobile WiMAX applications.
a broadband SiGe power amp in a polar transmitter using envelope tracking for mobile WiMAX has been presented.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of a broadband cascode PA for the ET-based polar TX in the mobile WiMAX application.
the design of a SiGe PA for a broadband polar TX system.
the design of broadband SiGe power amplifiers in an efficient polar transmitters using envelope-tracking for 3.5-GHz mobile WiMAX.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the ET technique can effectively linearize the saturated SiGe PA, and that this ET-based polar TX is suitable for the broadband and high-efficiency dual-mode WiMAX system.
the ET-based polar TX using the cascode SiGe HBT PA is a promising solution to the high efficiency and linearity requirements of the next generation wireless communication systems.
our saturated cascoded SiGe PA can achieve the high PAE of 35.2% at the output power of 22.4 dBm and the high linearity of EVM<2% at the average power of 18.4 dBm for 2.3 GHz WiMAX 16-QAM signals.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully designed a broadband cascode PA for dual-mode WiMAC applications, and the ET scheme has been successfully applied to the polar TX system to improve the linearity and PAE.
a SiGe cascode PA is suitable for the ET-based polar TX for WiMAX applications.
the ET-based TX system with our saturated cascode PA is a promising solution for the broadband polar TX system with high linearity and efficiency.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a broadband cascode PA can be efficiently linearized by the polar TX system.
the ET scheme can be effectively used for the linearization of the saturated PA in the polar TX system, which can be applied to the dual-mode WiMAX systems.
the ET scheme can be effectively used to linearize broadband SiGe power amplifiers for mobile WiMAX systems.
